title: Use HDMI-CEC to turn on connected HDMI screens on session start
line: A TV connected over HDMI now turns on and switches to the computer's input when the session starts or the screen wakes up.
explanation: Nothing in Plasma used HDMI-CEC, so a TV used as a monitor stayed in standby when the session started even though the GPU exposes a CEC adapter for that HDMI/DP connector (/dev/cecN). Other devices turn TVs on with CEC One Touch Play, Plasma never did. KWin's DRM backend now finds the CEC adapter that belongs to the output's DRM connector (CEC_ADAP_G_CONNECTOR_INFO) whenever an output goes from off/disabled to on, claims a Playback logical address if none is set, and sends Image View On to the TV plus an Active Source broadcast, on a worker thread so the compositor never blocks.

commits.message:
backends/drm: turn on HDMI-CEC TVs when their output is turned on

TVs used as monitors stayed off when the session started, because KWin
never talked to them over HDMI-CEC. Now, when an output is enabled or
woken up, it sends One Touch Play through the connector's CEC adapter.

BUG: 524509

media.caption: Master: KWin's real DRM backend (mock DRM test) enables, wakes and re-enables the output; the fake CEC adapter on that connector receives nothing.

With the fix: at session start, on wake from screen-off and on re-enable, the TV gets Image View On (40 04) and Active Source (4f 82 10 00); no message when the output was already on or for a connector without CEC.
